meta.title: Session Enhance
meta.description: Inspect any session and all of its subagents by ID (plus a title-bar copy-ID button), share a session as a read-only link, retry a turn the user interrupted (the official Continue action covers model failures only), run "Lianggu" — an off-peak session that pauses during DeepSeek official peak hours (Beijing time Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, statutory holidays excluded) and resumes automatically otherwise (toggle at the top right) — and use Claude Code-style tiered context compaction (auto/manual, toggleable in settings).
